text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—I've always liked fun stuff way more
than troublesome things.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hey yo, Jordan☆
Wanna grab burgers after school?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Apparently Jordan's favorite brand is doing a collab right now.
She said you can get a special shopping bag!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Fo' real!? We totally have to go, right!?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Wait up, Jordan!
Apparently bananas count as snacks!
Don't forget your shopping bag!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Whaat, really~!?
Then buy me some bananas too~...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, that has nothing to do with it?!
It's not like I even want a banana!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ahahahaha, bummer!!
Well then, see ya next time!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Haaah... What!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Umm... so, what should we do?
Wanna hang out after school?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Whatcha wanna do, whatcha wanna do~☆
Eat, chat, and chill out?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ah! About that...—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
(Golshi is... seriously total nonsense, but Palmer and Helios are super great buddies.
They're both such a vibe. Total love for them.)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Shoot, it's almost time...

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, Jordan-san!!
Regarding your contemporary literature assignment!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ehh...? Teach, your face is waaay too scary.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Of course I look scary! Didn't I tell everyone
to try solving them on their own at least once?!
Why did you just copy all the answers?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ah... that is, well... I did try to solve it, but, how should I put it...

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
...*sigh*, I understand feeling unmotivated.
But you can't stay like that forever, you know?
You need to get into the habit of putting in effort...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Bee-bee-bee-bee-beep...)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ah. Shoot, it's time for my nail appointment!
See ya, teach☆

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Nae...!? We have more important things to talk about!
Jordan-san, wait right there!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ehhー!? You're chasing after me~!?
For real~?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On this day, I was called to the Chairwoman's office along with other Trainers.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"Blessings upon you! To all the Trainers taking on the Junior Class
with their trainees starting this year! I wish you the best of luck!!"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: I will explain things to each of their homeroom teachers from my end. Please coordinate with them as necessary and guide the Umamusume in your charge.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Umamusume are racers, but at the same time,
they are also students.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
May you all have a fruitful three years.
We will be cheering you on all the wayâª

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Oh. Jordan, there you are—... wait,
you're doing your nails today too? Top coat?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh, City?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
(City does modeling on top of racing.
She's seriously amazing. I've got nothing but mad respect for her!)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
So, here's a message from the teacher.
You have supplementary lessons, so you need to talk with your Trainer and pick a date.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: !? Sorry! Did you have a message for City...?!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Don't worry about it. I had some free time, so it was on my way.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Still, you're seriously clumsy.
Did you even explain things properly to the teacher in the first place?"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I really tried to solve every single one of them,
but I couldn't read any of the kanji in the questions.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: She said the whole day ended while she was looking up the readings of kanji on her phone.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...How do you know that?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Ticket-senpai was shouting and crying out in the plaza earlier.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"She was like, "Last night, Jordan was
studying super hard in her room!""

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ah... That totally sounds like something she'd say...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
“Still... I don't know
what to say to make Teacher understand either.”

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Even so,
trying to get your feelings across is what matters.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: "People already misunderstand you easily as it is."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Okaaay.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Nn... Well then,
here's the real reason I'm here. Take a look at this.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
This is a recommended sports polish.
I heard you're stepping up your nail care.
I mean, you're starting today, right?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...! Thanks!!
Right, it starts today, doesn't it!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: You know, my—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —It's time for training with Tosen Jordan. I head to the track right on time.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Oh shoot... they're already here.
I'm still totally barefoot, though."
choice_data_list: Was coming by right now a bad idea?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
My nails aren't dry yet.
...Can't run right now. They'll chip. Wait up.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ah. And so, um...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"...Man, you know, you never
really get mad at times like this, do you?"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Don't make excuses like that—"
or "Stop fiddling with your nails all the time—" and stuff.
choice_data_list: Because if we do that, I won't get to hear what you have to say.
Because if we do that, I won't get to hear what you have to say.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
So, going back to what I was saying—you know how weak my nails are, right?
If I don't care for them, I can't put any power into my runs.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
And like, if it breaks, it's such a pain.
Can't even run in races, y'know? Aaaand then—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...I really wanted to finish my maintenance, but.
I was getting chased by the teacher, ya know?
And, well, how should I put it...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Ah... And then...
Hmm...?
choice_data_list: You just ran out of time, huh.
You just ran out of time, huh.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ! Totally! Exactly that!
choice_data_list: Once your hooves are dry, let's get training.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Goooot it.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
(And right in front of me is my Trainer.
Different from normal adults somehow.
Not that I really get how, though.)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
(Still, my Trainer really gives off
that quintessential Trainer vibe, y'know?)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Four. One more to go!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Piece of cake!
I mean, we've got the debut race coming up, right?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Also, looks like I've got makeup classes.
It'd be super bad if it overlaps with my debut race,
so go talk to the teacher for me~.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I just told you! Besides, you're a Trainer and an adult, aren'tcha? Put in a good word with teach' for me!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I might be an idiot,
but I'll give it my all when I run!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our days of taking on the Twinkle Series
with Tosen Jordan began!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Whoa.
That's crazy.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: ? Jordan, what's the matter?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ah. It's nothing~. Just thinking, like, I wanna go buy a new base coat?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, your nails are totally black~. Crazy.
It's like all-natural nail art. That's kinda growing on me.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Seriously, I just try doing a little something,
and you go and do this right away, nails~.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Geez. Now that you were born as my claws,
you'd better keep up with my running, got it~?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Because I'm definitely gonna win in a race!
